agent.problem: The blank asks the baker to complete the unseen wording of Gabriel's statement with “Holy.” “Chosen” and “Anointed” are also plausible Bible-sounding titles, so the card tests wording rather than a meaning the baker can reasonably work out.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
